Source: gpui-component 0.5.0 from crates.io, Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-APACHE).
Only src/text/node.rs and src/text/text_view.rs differ from upstream.

MR.DE adds TextView::on_image_click, an opt-in callback receiving an image URI,
its title/alt text, Window and App. It is installed at render time, so cached
parses and background reparses use the current callback. Image links keep their
upstream behavior when the callback is absent; when present, the callback takes
precedence. No Markdown splitting or global URL interception is involved.

A debug selector identifies rendered images in native interaction tests.
Regression coverage lives in mrde-app's UI tests. Remove this local patch once
a compatible upstream release exposes an image-click callback.

List items (src/text/node.rs, render_list_item): the item text container is
`div().flex_1().min_w_0().overflow_hidden()` instead of `div().overflow_hidden()`.
Upstream, `overflow: hidden` gives the text column an automatic minimum width of 0 and
no flex growth, so list item text collapsed to zero width and lists rendered as empty
bullets. Verified with `MRDE_SCENARIO=detail:description` screenshots.

Tables (src/text/node.rs, render_table): cells use flex-basis 0 with a flex-grow of
sqrt(text length) and wrap their text, instead of `w(relative(len))` plus `truncate()`.
Upstream clipped every long cell on one line (GPUI 0.2.2 also paints truncation from a
stale measurement). Verified on real MR descriptions with long table cells.

Root spacing (src/text/node.rs, render_block for Node::Root): each root block receives
`is_last` for its own position. Upstream passed `is_last: true` to every block of a
non-scrollable TextView, so paragraphs, lists, and tables lost their bottom gap and
headings touched the preceding text.
